description: cJSON 1.7.18 (git tag, commit-pinned, fetched into tests/tools) built by hcc, with its 21 Unity test programs. src/*: hcc compiles one file and every test program is relinked and must give gcc's per-case results. tests/<prog>.c: one unit-test file by hcc. case/<prog>/<case>: one RUN_TEST case of an entirely hcc-built program. Driver: tests/drivers/cjson.py
